headline: Rogers State's unbeaten start ends at home
dek: Saint Mary's won at Rogers State on Saturday, the hosts' first defeat in six matches. Rogers State have still scored fourteen goals through ten different players, more than any other programme, and Fort Hays State, who host them on the opening night of conference play, have drawn their last two matches.
displaced_by: Rogers State's first defeat, at home to Saint Mary's on 2026-09-12; the standing dek's unbeaten run and its goal figures no longer hold.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Harding have lost all four of their matches, conceding ten goals and scoring once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's match at home to UT Dallas on Saturday is the one match past its date with no result published.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Newman have lost five matches in a row since their opening win at William Jewell, the latest at West Texas A&M on Saturday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Hays State have drawn their last two matches, at home to Fort Lewis and at Lubbock Christian, and their one defeat was at home to Regis.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's ten goals have come from seven different players, and the three they have conceded all came in the defeat by Dallas Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrew Wagenblatt has made twenty-two saves for Harding, with no shutout to show for them.

last_match.line: Rogers State had won every home match before this; they open conference play at Fort Hays State on Thursday.

next_match.line: Oklahoma Christian have beaten Newman but lost at Northeastern State and at Rogers State; Southern Nazarene arrive from defeat at Midwestern State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
